subject: STOP statement
notes: kb/Work/PB411.md - LANDED, the twin of SR-14.9.18.3-8 at the shared screen: 'case BoundStringLiteral { Value.Length: 0 }' -> COBOL1704 citing SR4, over the alphanumeric, national and boolean zero-length forms alike.
